200.description: Reminder request processed. For targeted requests, inspect each entry in recipients for acceptance or failure; HTTP 200 does not mean all selected recipients succeeded. An envelope-wide request returns an empty object when DocuSign accepts it, because individual recipient outcomes are not returned. Acceptance does not confirm delivery.

schema.description: For targeted reminders, recipients contains exactly one outcome for each requested recipient ID. HTTP 200 can include accepted and failed outcomes, including when every recipient failed at the provider after validation. Invalid selections detected before the resend return 400 instead. Envelope-wide acceptance returns an empty object; do not infer individual outcomes. There is no overall status field. Authentication, validation, rate-limit, upstream, and timeout errors use the documented 4xx/5xx responses.

recipients.description: Outcomes for the selected recipients, present for targeted requests and omitted for envelope-wide reminders. A timeout or missing provider outcome must not be represented as confirmed acceptance or failure.

recipientId.description: Selected DocuSign signer ID from the request

status.description: accepted means DocuSign accepted the reminder request for this recipient, not confirmed delivery. failed means DocuSign returned a definitive recipient-level failure.

message.description: Explanation of a recipient-level failure, when available
message.example: Recipient is no longer eligible for a reminder.

schema.title: AddDocusignEnvelopeRemindersResponse

selectedRecipients.summary: One reminder accepted and one failed after validation

recipients.message: Recipient is no longer eligible for a reminder.

envelopeWide.summary: Envelope-wide reminder accepted without individual outcomes

400.description: Invalid parameters, missing DocuSign configuration, ineligible envelope state, or unknown or ineligible signers. Null or empty recipientIds arrays, duplicate IDs, and null, blank, or non-string entries are rejected. The singular recipientId field is not accepted. Draft and terminal envelopes cannot be reminded.

403.description: Write access to the selected document or artifact is denied

404.description: Document, artifact, or associated DocuSign envelope not found

502.description: DocuSign authentication failure, upstream error, or invalid response

504.description: DocuSign request timed out; reminder delivery outcome is unknown
